integrity_statement: The narrowed singular crossover follows analytically from killed-interval first-exit probabilities, renewal and a uniform low-rate expansion. Earlier renewal, Gumbel and size-bias statements are explicitly credited to prior work. Finite numerical checks do not prove the limit.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional zero-drift Brownian motion with independent Poisson resets to the starting point, a fixed target and diffusion coefficient, and a threshold scaled with kappa m -> u in (0,infinity). No general-clock or endpoint u=0/infinity claim.
title: A singular low-reset-rate Bernoulli law for extreme pre-absorption Brownian excursions
